newsitem.title: TURKEY: BASKETBALL-EFES BEAT PAU IN OVERTIME TO WIN GROUP STAGE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-EFES BEAT PAU IN OVERTIME TO WIN GROUP STAGE.

text.p: Efes Pilsen of Turkey won their EuroLeague basketball clash with Pau Orthez of France 78-76 in overtime on Thursday to clinch the group D honours.
With one match remaining in the first phase of games, they cannnot be caught after disposing of Pau, their nearest rivals.

After a bad start in which they scored only two points in the first five minutes Efes Pilsen recovered through sound defence and accurate long-range shooting, but still trailed the French team 25-37 at the end of the first half.
By the 27th minute the Turks had caught up, however, and it was neck and neck from then on, the two sides finishing 64-64 at the end of normal time.
Efes managed to sneak ahead through defensive mistakes from Pau and much-needed three-point baskets from Petar Naumowski and Ufuk Sarica led them to victory.
